issues.reason: "Never coin a relation head ... a verb, noun or adjective from the sentence never becomes a new UpperCamelCase head — the property a Member / Inheritance atom"; the sole open-class exception is a mutual predicate the copula itself asserts, and here "algorithmically equivalent" is attributive, so AlgorithmicallyEquivalent is outside the vocabulary.

The dangle is real — the compound symbol was defined and never used — but the genus atom is not itself defective (a compound property's genus is licensed, as sensitive_to_light shows); it is a symptom of issue 0 and goes live once the modifier is encoded as a property.

Categorical statements: "A property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol ... a bare (Member <group> <prop>) appears only for a property genuinely of the collection itself (its size, its name)" — random is neither, so (Member sk_way_1 random) asserts the forbidden group-as-object reading.

Cardinality / Quantifiers: a plural with a distributive predicate keeps the group event and count and ADDS the per-member rule over (PartOf $x <group>); "can be defined" is not a collective predicate, so the rule is required.

gaps_confirmed: attributive relational/symmetric adjective inside an NP ("these mutually equivalent Ns") — the symmetric machinery is defined for predicative use only, and the plural-modifier rule offers a distributing property or a fusing classifier, neither of which records the mutuality
new_gaps: an adverb+adjective compound property (algorithmically_equivalent) has no stated decomposition rule — Compound concepts covers verb+object, phrasal verbs, modifier+noun and the fused adjective+complement only, so the genus atom is by analogy
repair_summary: Replaced the coined-head pairwise rule with the licensed distribution of the modifier as a property, (Implication (PartOf $x sk_seq_1) (Member $x algorithmically_equivalent)) at 1.0/0.9, which also puts the existing genus atom to work; replaced (Member sk_way_1 random) with the per-member distribution (Implication (PartOf $x sk_way_1) (Member $x random)); added the per-member define rule define_dist alongside the group event.
notes: The mutuality of the equivalence is lost by the repair and is recorded as the confirmed gap — no licensed encoding carries it attributively. The group witnesses, Cardinality 3, agentless passive with (Can e) and the (In ...) oblique were left untouched.
